checks.steps: Play 1080p media for 60 s with the bars shown, then for 60 s with Hide UI on. Sample the CPU with top -pid.
checks.expect: CPU with the bars shown is not much higher than with Hide UI on: no constant redraw while idle.

checks.steps: Enter fullscreen while playing, keep the mouse still for the auto-hide delay, then move it.

checks.steps: While playing, click PiP in the top bar. Then click the placeholder. Then close the PiP window.

checks.steps: Reopen a partially watched file with the window 640 pt wide and the compact library open. Then widen the window to full width.

checks.steps: Install the current HEAD build. Open 1080p test media from ../build/media in a 1728×1001 window and play. Run `top -l 30 -stats pid,cpu -pid <pid>` for 30 s in each state: (a) bars visible, pointer still; (b) Hide UI (⌘\); (c) PiP; (d) a continuous scrub drag; (e) the window fully covered by another app's window; (f) app hidden (⌘H).
checks.expect: (a) averages at most (b) + 2 pp. (e) and (f) are at or below (b). The scrub may be higher but drops back within 1 s of release.

checks.steps: Pause playback. Drag the seek head slowly from 20 % to 80 % and back, then press → and ← several times while paused. Enable System Settings › Accessibility › Display › Reduce motion and play for 5 s.
checks.expect: The head, fill, elapsed label and preview follow the pointer continuously with no freeze. Paused jumps move the head immediately. Under Reduce Motion the head steps once per second. The paused-seek still shows the frame at the new time, including with a subtitle track selected and with flip, rotate or crop 2.35:1 applied, where it should match the vout's geometry.

checks.steps: With natural scrolling on, swipe two fingers up on the trackpad over the volume cone, then over the video. Repeat with Settings › Reverse scroll direction on, and with a mouse wheel.
checks.expect: The same physical gesture changes the volume in the same direction over the cone and over the video in every combination. Scrolling over the cone never also seeks or scrolls anything else.

checks.steps: Open a live (non-seekable) stream. Look at the elapsed label, Tab to it with Full Keyboard Access, press Space, and query it with VoiceOver (VO-F3).
checks.expect: The label is at full FG/A2 (not dimmed) and shows the design focus ring with no system ring. Space does nothing on a live stream and opens the editor on seekable media. VoiceOver reads 'Edit playback time', the value, and 'Not available for this stream', each once.

checks.steps: Play 2.39:1 media in a 16:9 window, open the compact library, and press C (crop) and other OSD shortcuts. Repeat with a right panel open.

criticAdd: C1 (A-window/B-controls): click the volume cone and the seek bar, then press Tab and arrow keys. Expect no system focus box at any point, and only the design ring under Full Keyboard Access.

C2 (G-panels): click the audio button, then the subtitles button. Expect the track popover anchored bottom-right above the bar with the right tab preselected, and the bar icon orange (subtitles as a filled caption box). Picking a row moves the orange ✓ and does not close the popover.

C4 (D-menus/G-panels): open and close the popover, queue, settings sidebar, ⋯ menu and a dialog, using Esc and a click outside each time, while playing. Expect the same open/close motion everywhere, and playback never pauses.
C7 (B-controls): change the volume with the scroll wheel, the arrow keys and the media keys. Expect only the cone tooltip as feedback, and no VLC core volume OSD.

MUST launch-to-Home (E-library): quit with nothing left to resume, then launch the app. Expect the full-window library on Home, not the cone screen. With a partially watched file, expect the resume toast centred above the bar, and the seek bar shows the tinted 0→saved span plus a marker.

MUST drag library→queue (E-library/G-panels): drag a row from the compact and the full library into the open queue, at the end and at a placeholder. Expect it to be added or inserted at the drop point.

MUST Add Subtitles mapping (G-panels/C-bridge): open Add Subtitles on a folder, map the files, press Save, then reopen another episode in that folder. Expect the tracks under External Tracks in the popover, still mapped after a relaunch.

MUST fullscreen bar reveal (A-window): in fullscreen, move the pointer near the top edge, then near the bottom edge. Expect only the matching bar to appear, the video not to jump, and no frame in fullscreen.
MUST ⌘B bookmark + chapters (G-panels): press ⌘B while playing. Expect a bookmark with no dialog and an OSD 'Pressed ⌘B'. Clicking a bookmark or chapter row seeks to it.

Settings in the real window (F-settings): open all 13 categories in Dark and Light at 1280×800 and screencapture each one. Compare with the Figma Settings renders. Advanced Options expands below with the chevron pointing down, and ⓘ opens on click with no hover delay.

H-05 accessibility (H-design): turn on Reduce Transparency, Differentiate Without Color and Increase Contrast one at a time. Check the bars, popups, the native menu bar, the AppKit menus and dialogs. Expect opaque surfaces, non-colour state cues and higher contrast, with no unreadable text.

Accent change (H-design): pick a different accent in Settings or onboarding. Expect every former orange to change, including the seek fill, active icons, the ✓ marks, the dialog primary button and chapter numbers.

Startup and memory (C-bridge/I-build): cold-launch to the first frame of a test episode, measured with os_signpost or a stopwatch. Measure RSS after 30 min of 1080p playback and after browsing Network and the library.
COMP-18 (C-bridge): drag an .srt onto the window in fullscreen, and open a file whose subtitle is auto-detected. Expect the subtitle to be added and selected, with no duplicate.
SET-04 (J-media-io): start a Stream job with 'keep' on and two items queued. Expect the receiver to get the second item with no reconnect.
Music layout (B-controls/E-library): play a song with 'Show Waveform on Seekbar' on. Expect the waveform bars (played part orange), the −15/+15 buttons beside play, and the audio now-playing view.
Open Network Stream and Network category (J-media-io/E-library): open an http URL through the dialog and browse SMB/UPnP shares. Expect no Enqueue action and no all-in-one Open dialog.

B-controls: C-09 / D039 HDR 'Off' trade-off: PausedStillLayout.allowsStill treats HDR overrides as never applied and keeps the still on. If the owner changes D039 so HDR modes are applied, HDR must be added to the still's suppressing filters.
B-controls: D033 subtitle font-size slider order: not touched by B-controls; no dependency.
B-controls: D047 (proportional time digits; paused still with subtitles on) was accepted by the fixer. It amends BB-12 and D038, so the owner may want to confirm it.

C-bridge: D045: extensions page, opaque light dialogs, track numbers from 1. The native extension dialogs (C-05) follow the current D045 implementation.
C-bridge: C-09 / D039: HDR 'Off' would force the caopengllayer vout and lose PiP and EDR. Until decided, Auto is the only honoured mode.
